children.value: > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried said that he found out about the fiat@ftx account — that’s the one that tracked how much Alameda owed FTX — in June 2022 while his senior staff was focused on fixing the software bug.
> > Fact From Story: He did not, however, discover what the account was for until October.
> > > Fact From Story: His employees told him “they were busy and I should stop asking questions because it was distracting.”
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Typically, a CEO would want to understand the purpose of a critical financial account as soon as possible.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Typically, a CEO would want to understand the purpose of a critical financial account as soon as possible.
> Commonsense Knowledge: It is unusual for a CEO to be told to stop asking questions about a multi-billion dollar issue by their employees.
